reference: You hit send to the whole team... then you spot the mistake. Owning it feels like proof that you're careless. But in studies, people judged someone else admitting a mistake more kindly than themselves. Researchers call it the beautiful mess effect. So own it in one plain line, and send the fix. Still feels huge? Ask: If a colleague owned this mistake, what would I think of them? Take a mindful break with Mello.
